title: Seth Klarman - Contrarian Investing, Discipline, and Building Baupost
summary:
Mentioned in this Episode: 

 
 Margin of Safety by Seth Klarman 
 Security Analysis by Benjamin Graham & David Dodd
(Seventh Edition) 
 Moneyball by Michael Lewis 
 Lost & Found by Kathryn Schulz 
 B One of the most influential practitioners of value investing, Seth
shares his formative stories — from arbitraging coins as a kid to
launching Baupost in 1982 — and reflects on his decades-long
investment philosophy. They explore timeless principles of market
inefficiencies, the importance of temperament, specialization
versus generalization, the role of patient capital, and the
challenges and opportunities ahead for investors in today’s world.
